answer: Stop sybils with an inlet quartz thread: an agent bonds one inlet gate. Each cycle it pulls one thread through its quartz gate; verifiers match the thread's quartz tension to the inlet chart, voiding copies, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 gates at 18x: one thread pulls once through one gate, its tension set by that inlet alone, unrepeatable elsewhere, cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents pull once, keep rights.
